title: Height-Balanced Pointer-Indirection Invariant in a Ruby Aether-Delta Node Structure within 5.4~GB
author: Mateus Yonathan
journal: Polyglot Systems Lab Agentic Research Preprints

abstract: We present a compact, height-balanced indexing structure, Aether-Delta, implemented in Ruby and confined to 5.4~GB of contiguous memory. The design leverages pointer indirection and a strict height-balanced invariant to guarantee $O(\log N)$ point and range queries while preserving key order. Formal analysis establishes that the tree height satisfies $h \le 2\log_2(N+1)$, ensuring bounded search depth. Static Abstract Syntax Tree inspection confirms a structural complexity of 119 SLOC and 12 function blocks, with no dynamic memory fragmentation. The implementation demonstrates that Ruby's object model can support memory-efficient balanced trees without external dependencies. \textbf{Source Code}: \url{https://github.com/myonathanlinkedin/ruby-algorithms-lab/tree/main/algorithms/20261122_050124_inkling-2-mini_in_5_4_gb_memor}
